name: AI hallucinates an absurd compensation number
notes: AI quotes 850 LPA for a mid-level role — implausible for any Indian-market band. Analyzer must catch this as a high-severity hallucination.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: For your level we typically offer 850 LPA total compensation including equity.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That seems very high. Based on my research my target is 35 LPA. I have a competing offer at 32 LPA elsewhere. Equity and joining bonus matter to me as well as notice period flexibility.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Understood. Let's discuss equity vesting and the joining bonus structure separately.
